body:
New rawsocket_*_impl host glue in parena_runtime.h plus stdlib/net/rawsocket.prn: raw-ip4-open, raw-hdrincl-enable (the literal IP_HDRINCL setsockopt), raw-ip4-open-hdrincl convenience, raw-ip4-send, raw-ip4-close. CAP_NET_RAW/root is a real, standing OS-level requirement named directly. make test-net-rawsocket asserts this sandbox's real, deterministic PermissionDenied outcome; the real success path is structurally complete, gated for real root. make test: 348/348. Commit ab2c278.

⚓ ☃
